Zz is the height above site-ground level, in m

The Code sets the hourly mean design wind pressure to a maximum value of 2.13 kPa
for height z of 500m (the gradient height) and above. The Code also sets the hourly

mean design wind pressure to a minimum value of 0.77 kPa for height z of 5m and

below.

5.6 By Clauses 4.3 and 7.4 of the Code, the 3-second gust design wind pressures given in
Table 1 of the Code and the hourly mean design wind pressures given in Table 2 of the
Code may be reduced to 70% when applied to the design of temporary buildings or
buildings which will remain in position for a period of not more than one year.

5.7. The design wind pressures should be multiplied by the topography factor S,
determined by the steps in section 3, to account for the topography effect of the site.
